parameters.query:
WITH request AS (
  SELECT data->>'eventId' AS event_id,
         data->>'ticket' AS ticket_text
  FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS data) x
),
new_checkin AS (
  INSERT INTO eventflow.checkins (event_id, qr_token)
  SELECT r.event_id, g.qr_token
  FROM request r
  JOIN eventflow.registrations g ON g.event_id = r.event_id
    AND g.qr_token::text = r.ticket_text
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING qr_token
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM new_checkin) THEN 'checked_in'
  WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM eventflow.checkins c
    JOIN request r ON c.event_id = r.event_id AND c.qr_token::text = r.ticket_text
  ) THEN 'already_checked_in'
  ELSE 'invalid_ticket'
END AS status;
